title: Archive & Backup
subtitle: Deleted agents, projects and users end up here instead of disappearing. The archive is also reachable as a network share.

storage.title: Storage
storage.subtitle: Where archives go and how much space they use.
storage.setup_failed: HydraHive could not set up the archive:
storage.default_hint: Default: next to the project data, on the same disk. HydraHive sets up the folder and the share itself.

share.title: Network share
share.subtitle: Open the archive in Windows Explorer or Finder – read and write.
share.no_samba: Samba is not installed. Without Samba there is no network share – the archive itself still works.
share.setup_failed: Could not start the Samba setup.
share.not_enabled: The share could not be created. The “Storage” section shows why.
share.hint: Files deleted through the share go to the recycle bin (.papierkorb) and stay there until it is emptied here.
share.switched_off: The share is switched off. The archive still works, just not over the network.
share.paused_for_move: The share is paused while the archive moves.

entries.title: Archived items
entries.subtitle: Everything in the archive. Restoring will come in a later stage.

trash.title: Empty recycle bin permanently
trash.text: The recycle bin holds {{size}}. These files will be deleted permanently.
trash.failed: Could not empty the recycle bin.

move.title: Change archive location
move.explain: All packages, manually placed files and the recycle bin move along. The network share pauses during the move; only after everything is copied and verified does the switch happen and the old location get cleaned up.
move.prepare_failed: The disk could not be prepared.
move.done: Move finished. The archive is now at {{target}}.
move.left_behind: Left at the old location (added during the move):

error.verify_failed: Move cancelled: the copy did not match the original. The archive is unchanged at the old location.
error.copy_failed: Move cancelled while copying. The archive is unchanged at the old location.
error.unexpected: Move cancelled. The archive is unchanged at the old location.

problem.current_inside_target: The current archive is inside it.
problem.target_not_writable: HydraHive may not write there yet.
